title: AI Provider Framework — implementation
summary: Provide a pluggable AI provider framework (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, future) with a registry, model selection, usage tracking and centralised prompt templates - without coupling to any one vendor. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: A new provider can be added by implementing the interface + registering it
The same calling code works across all providers
Model selection and usage tracking work for every provider
Prompt templates are centralised and versioned
Local Ollama works with no paid credentials
notes:
Scope (in): AIProvider abstraction with Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini implementations; Provider registry; Model selection per provider; Usage tracking; Prompt templates
Out of scope: User-supplied credentials/encryption (EPIC-009); Producing model critiques (EPIC-010); Allowing AI to influence scoring (forbidden - EPIC-003 stays deterministic)
